name: OverWatch
vision: market tools feel dense, number-heavy, and intimidating especially for people who do not enjoy complex metrics or math. OverWatch addresses this by taking real live data from CMC and presenting it in a way that feels alive and human instead of technical.

name: Catalyst Edge
vision: Catalyst Edge turns live CoinMarketCap data into ranked, explainable long and short research setups with transparent entry, target, invalidation, and risk levels.
team_description: Independent builder combining market analysis, explainable scoring, and product development to make live crypto signals easier to inspect and evaluate.

name: Will RWA Let Me In
vision: My vision is to make RWA investing as simple as asking a question: an agent helps you understand the assets, check what you can access, and prepare transactions you review and sign in your own wallet.
team_description: Solo project by Robin, combining RWA research, product design and AI-assisted development. I built Will RWA Let Me In and VaultTerms to help people understand tokenized assets, check access requirements and take action through their own wallets.

name: Crypto Derivatives Risk Radar
vision: Turn fragmented crypto-derivatives data into a live, transparent view of where market stress is building and what is driving it.
team_description: olo project by Callum Connell, a Theoretical Physics graduate with a focus on quantitative finance, statistical modelling and software development. I designed and built the full CDRR stack independently, including the CoinMarketCap data collector, derivatives-data processing pipeline, volatility and risk models, forward-validation framework, FastAPI backend, Next.js frontend and production VPS deployment. The project combines quantitative research with practical engineering to turn fragmented crypto-derivatives data into an interpretable live risk-monitoring system.

name: TrendLab Market Structure Map
vision: TrendLab helps crypto researchers distinguish broad market participation from moves driven by only large-cap assets or a narrow category, so they can use more precise language before publishing a market narrative.
team_description: Solo project by Sasha, a crypto researcher and content creator. Responsibilities: product framing, market-research methodology, data interpretation, demo, and distribution.

name: Elephant Tracks
vision: Every DEX flow tool reduces the tape to one signed number, and that number cannot tell one desk selling into a crowd from a thousand matched pairs. Elephant Tracks makes the shape of flow readable from data anyone can already fetch.
team_description: Solo build by Edy Cu. A keyless CLI and a static page that split DEX flow by maker address: 111 tests at 100% coverage of scripts/, a 6-stage CI whose last stage runs the real API call with no secret configured, and every published number traceable to a committed receipt.

name: CMC-Alpha-Terminal
vision: An institutional-grade, zero-heap quantitative screening engine and FastMCP agent gateway powered by the CoinMarketCap Pro API with Power of 10 Deterministic Safety Invariants.
team_description: Solo Quantitative Developer & System Engineer specializing in deterministic C++20 trading architectures, low-latency market data processing, and FastMCP AI agent integrations adhering strictly to Gerard J. Holzmann Power of 10 Safety Invariants.
